name: scrapecreators-api
description: >- Scrape and extract public data from 27+ social media platforms using the ScrapeCreators REST API. Covers TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter/X, Reddit, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Snapchat, Twitch, Kick, Truth Social, TikTok Shop, Google, and link-in-bio services (Linktree, Komi, Pillar, Linkbio, Linkme, Amazon Shop). Use when the user asks to scrape, fetch, extract, search, or look up social media profiles, posts, videos, reels, comments, transcripts, followers, ads, has
author: ScrapeCreators
summary_zh: 一个聚合多平台公开数据的 REST API，适合抓取社交账号、帖子、评论和视频等内容，用于舆情监测与数据分析。
